scope: Simple pair bench inside the full game with a loaded save (original with the function hook off vs candidate with the hook on), 15488 isolated CPU pairs for 66 pending functions of CPostEffects, FxSystem_c, ALL pairs equal, pair counts equal to the bank table, passed=true globally, natural "complete" event with state_restored, saves unchanged, configs restored. Each case rebuilds the same deterministic fixture (seed = case index) in both legs and compares the return value, the bytes of the fake objects, the touched global ranges, the x87 control word (24 bits) and the whole trace of doubled collaborators with raw arguments; foreign threads ignored. Traced doubles get NO credit. Only the own part of each function is validated. Source tested == current working tree at registration (class sources match the probe build manifest). Historical evidence approved with explicit limits; no current dependency accreditation. Limits: fake RwEngineInstance device (nothing draws), fake FxSystem_c/primitives/particles with a fixed arena for CMemoryMgr::Malloc, RW raster/camera/lights/RNG and audio doubled with trace; fixtures without signalling NaN, with at most one NaN operand in two-operand operations, and without inputs that make the EXE read uninitialised locals or loop forever. CPostEffects::Render has LIMITED SCOPE: the photo-saving branch (0x705301..0x7053E3, real file I/O) is outside the bank and avoided by the fixtures. No pending function of the two classes was left out of the bank (FxSystem_c::Update, AddParticle, GetBoundingBox, UpdateBoundingBoxCB, HeatHazeFX, Radiosity, SpeedFX, DrawQuadSet* and RasterCreatePostEffects are not in the pending list). Revalidado el 2026-10-26 tras reconstruir colaboradores (lote 67 y anteriores); el banco se adapto a ellos (ver su README.md).
